description: Call this when you need to pick a store for a product need and want one where a saved check shows an agent reached checkout. Filters: category or q (shopper words), limit (default 5). Returns total, the store hosts with checked_at, and a full_list link. Example: find_stores({"category":"running shoes","limit":3}) → {"total":12,"stores":[{"host":"…","checked_at":"…"}],…}. A store missing from the list is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

category.description: Category or shopper words, such as footwear or running shoes.

limit.description: How many stores to return. Default 5.

q.description: Product need, such as skincare or camping gear.

name: find_stores
title: Find stores
